name: Toggle
description: Two-state button that turns an option on or off, such as bold text formatting. Use alone or inside `ToggleGroup`. Renders a `<button>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the toggle, controlling its height and width. Inside a `ToggleGroup`, falls back to the group's `size` when not set.

props.name: variant
props.description: Color style of the toggle, applied to its content and to its background while pressed.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description:
Whether the toggle button is currently pressed.
This is the uncontrolled counterpart of `pressed`.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Callback fired when the pressed state is changed.

props.name: pressed
props.description:
Whether the toggle button is currently pressed.
This is the controlled counterpart of `defaultPressed`.

props.name: value
props.description:
A unique string that identifies the toggle when used
inside a toggle group.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown inside the toggle, such as an icon. A single element child is hidden from assistive technologies, so give the toggle an `aria-label`.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Toggle.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
